decisions.reason: The mitred door lever handle family has only been mentioned on the website without a dedicated page or awards, signaling weak early results and low differentiation despite related knowledge, so management drops it to free resources.

The multifunctional door lever handle's move to a dedicated page in 2024 indicates promising early results and the firm's ability to assimilate feedback using its existing door-handle expertise, so it is kept.
As a standard door lever handle closely related to the firm's core capabilities, its steady presence suggests it remains a viable staple in the product range.

The award-winning door and window handle collection with dedicated pages and quantified design awards shows strong market recognition and high absorptive capacity, making it very unlikely to be dropped.
